topic: AI repurposing system: 1 video into 10 pieces of content
image_subtext: The AI repurposing system every smart creator runs.

captions.x:
Stop creating more. Start multiplying.

1 video → AI transcribes it → 3 tweets, 2 reel scripts, 1 blog post, 1 email, 3 quote graphics.

10 pieces of content from 1 idea. AI does the heavy lifting.

#ContentCreation #AIAutomation #CreatorEconomy
